records.title: Solving systems of diagonal polynomial equations over finite fields
records.supported_claim: Constant-degree univariate HPGP-prime over prime fields with growing parameter dimension is already quantum polynomial time.
records.transfer_gate: Fixed-field incidence decoding is a known-easy baseline. No novelty claim or free prime-power transfer.

records.title: Cyclotomic Cosets: Hidden Subgroup and Quantum Sieving Algorithm for Prime-Power Moduli
records.supported_claim: Low-only zero-sum selection preserves uniform high lifts; published sieve accounts for successive levels and secret-digit recursion.
records.transfer_gate: Our weighted integer-secret line source has its own exact unimodular proof; it is not automatically a general ring-secret sieve improvement.

records.title: Optimal algorithms for learning quantum phase states
records.supported_claim: The generalized separable learner uses copies of one Boolean-domain unknown polynomial, assumes even q and explicitly charges q dependence.
records.transfer_gate: It does not prove a learner for varying native ternary packets with growing prime-power root order.
